parsed.post: Kept: reducing batch size to 262144 improved val_bpb from 0.8635 to 0.8538. More optimizer steps within the 5-minute window are helping. Next, I'll test increasing DEPTH to 8 to see if the increased capacity combined with more steps further improves performance.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 while keeping the reduced batch size of 262144 and full shards (0-10) to maximize capacity and optimizer steps.
